text: In connection with the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus, our subsidiary has entered into a phased lease with the DOE at the DOE Portsmouth Site.
summary: SB Energy's subsidiary holds a phased lease with the U.S. Department of Energy at the DOE Portsmouth Site in Pike County, Ohio. The campus is designed as 17 data center buildings aggregating approximately 8.0 GW-IT of critical IT capacity, representing 10 GW of gross power load. First phase targets commencement of operations in 2028.
notes: Site sits at the confluence of seven major high-voltage transmission lines; that capacity was available in part because of the retirement of the DOE's Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant. Campus occupies roughly 640 acres of the 3,775-acre DOE site (acreage from secondary sources, not the filing). DOE previously listed the plant among 16 federal sites for rapid data center construction. Groundbreaking ceremony March 20, 2026.
confidence_note: Filing read in original. Acreage and groundbreaking date are from secondary coverage and are not verified against the filing.
